description: Configuration for the meta-monitor + its investigation. A process is registered with an EFFORT signal (work it produces) and a PAYOFF signal (the target). window/effort_min_rise/payoff_flat_band/payoff_improve_band govern the spinning flag (effort climbing while payoff stays flat). When flagged, the agent does not ASSUME the cause — it INVESTIGATES with a do-contrast declared HERE, per process: `intervention` names a graph attr to toggle (toggle_type/toggle_attr) between with_value and without_value, so the agent can measure the payoff WITH its effort's output active vs WITHOUT. If toggling barely moves the payoff (|with - without| <= connection_band) the effort can't reach the payoff -> disconnected_lever; the lever is the wrong one. All of it is data here, not Python.

unit_segmentation._note: effort = distinct units coined (lexicon size); payoff = next-unit predictability over chance. Watches PERCEPTION, not recognition: if the agent keeps coining more units while its own units stay unpredictable, the segmentation lever is spinning.
